description: This file implements a utility object 'WinChecker' for evaluating the game state of Tic Tac Toe, specifically checking for a winner and draw conditions, based on the 'Board' and 'Player' domain models.

classes.name: WinChecker
classes.description: A singleton utility object for evaluating game outcomes in Tic Tac Toe.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner player, if any, by checking all possible winning lines on the board.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Evaluates whether the game is a draw, meaning the board is full and there is no winner.

methods.name: threeEqual
methods.description: Helper method to check if three board cells contain the same non-null Player, indicating a winning line.
